draft_en.subject: The Monad-branded industrial switches - managed 8-PoE, and whether bypass is still required
draft_en.body:
Dear Mr. Lee,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 15 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the Monad-branded industrial switches, in your housing from small lots, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed, Marvell-based - model STI-288GPM - $85.5 USD EXW with your logo (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); and, if the bypass requirement is still live, an 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 4 x SFP L2+ unit with hardware fibre bypass (link stays up when the unit loses power) - $202.1. KC stays on your side.

One question: is bypass still a requirement in your current projects, or has it dropped out of the spec?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
